name: Premium Hostile Combat Hull Repair

native_english_localization.description: Repairs a percentage of hull damage taken during each round of combat against non-Armada hostiles.

modeled_behavior.rank_selection: owned research rank minus one selects a total fraction; do not sum earlier ranks
modeled_behavior.scope: NPC hostiles, excluding Armada hulls and group/solo/outpost Armada engagement tags
modeled_behavior.after_lethal_round: no following round and no repair

validation.source: Sanitized automatic Realta combat journal, October 23, 2026

limitations: Condition224 is absent from the inspected native client BuffCondition enum and executable condition evaluator. Its TargetNotSoloArmada interpretation is inferred from other BuffSpecs and their localized Group Armada descriptions, not independently proved in server code.
For the modeled non-Armada hostile subset, localized scope and the exact observed repair independently establish eligibility; this does not generalize unknown condition224 to other contexts.
The native RoundEnd effect is represented by the existing previous-round damage channel at the following RoundStart to match journal ordering and avoid repairing after a lethal round.
